name: Eye's Only ~Sono Kagayaki wa Mabushisa ni Michite~
original_name: eye’s only～その輝きはまぶしさに満ちて～
source: It's spring time, and Yousuke is entering university. In these three months until summer vacation, he meets some interesting girls and starts to have a relationship with them.
translation: 春天到来，洋介也即将进入大学。在暑假前的三个月里，他会邂逅几名有趣的少女，并开始与她们交往。
